records.title: Multi-Dimensional Comparative Scale Construction for Efficient Personalized Subjective Judgment in High-Traffic Applications
records.reason: Constructs personalized subjective-judgment scales for high-traffic applications; not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: BaatCheet: A Multilingual Corpus for Dialogue Translation in Indian Languages
records.reason: Introduces a multilingual dialogue-translation corpus; dataset creation is not inference/serving optimization.

records.title: AgentLoop: Runtime Control of Slot-closed Execution Loops for Tool-augmented LLM Agents
records.reason: Controls tool-agent completion loops to stop redundant reasoning, but the abstract contribution concerns runtime task-completion signals and agent workflow control rather than model inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: Separating Memory and Workflow Effects in Predicting Individual Answers
records.reason: Studies personalized-answer quality effects of memory and workflow choices; it does not propose inference-cost reduction.

records.title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
records.reason: Introduces a self-modifying visual backbone with test-time training; the target is visual representation learning, not LLM serving.
